chunks.label: Deciding and arranging
chunks.rationale: Say what you decided, what got decided for you, and what you were told to do.
chunks.interference: koto ni suru (you chose) vs koto ni naru (it was decided or turned out that way).

chunks.label: Credit and blame
chunks.rationale: Say what helped, what's to blame, and excuse yourself.
chunks.interference: okage de is for good results, no sei de for bad ones.

chunks.label: Pretending and trying
chunks.rationale: Talk about pretending, attempts that got cut off, and what you won't do.
chunks.interference: -ou to suru (tried, was about to) vs -te goran and -te miru (try it and see).

chunks.label: Can, must and needn't
chunks.rationale: Fuller ways to say what's allowed, possible, pointless, out of the question or right.
chunks.interference: koto wa nai (no need) vs -ta koto wa nai (never have); wake ni wa ikanai vs wake ja nai.

chunks.label: When it happens
chunks.rationale: Say how often, since when, and at what moment something happened.
chunks.interference: -ru koto ga aru (sometimes) vs -ta koto ga aru (have ever).

chunks.label: Very polite speech
chunks.rationale: Understand and use the keigo of shops, offices and polite requests.
chunks.interference: kudasaru (they kindly do it for you) vs itadaku (you humbly receive it).

chunks.label: Quoting and referring
chunks.rationale: Ask whether, pass on what you heard, sum it up, and refer back to what was said.
chunks.interference: to ieba (speaking of X) vs sou ieba (that reminds me).

chunks.label: Seeming and sure
chunks.rationale: Say how sure you are, from 'seems' to 'must be' to 'not necessarily'.

chunks.label: Ifs and hopes
chunks.rationale: Suppose things, set conditions and limits, and hope out loud.
chunks.interference: -to ii (I hope) vs -tara ii (you should); sae areba (as long as) vs de sae (even).

chunks.label: Even though
chunks.rationale: Push back, complain, make allowances and play things down.
chunks.interference: ni shite wa (for a) vs ni shite mo (even allowing for); kuse ni vs the neutral -noni.

chunks.label: Even and let alone
chunks.rationale: Go one step further: far from, not only, rather, even.
chunks.interference: dokoro ka flips the expectation; dake de naku just adds to it.

chunks.label: Point of view
chunks.rationale: Say in what role, for whom, toward whom and about what.
chunks.interference: ni totte (from X's view) vs no tame ni (for X's benefit); -muke vs -muki.

chunks.label: Noun add-ons
chunks.rationale: Small endings that make a noun a type, a whole, a without, or a game.

chunks.label: Casual emphasis
chunks.rationale: Overdo it, insist, and refuse with feeling.
